request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Use the input only as a tactile premium quality reference. Fully redesign Buki's first screen, not a recolor. Make the exact word "Buki" from four rounded soft-clay letter blocks in a compact top card. Move the sketchpad chooser into a tiny icon chip attached to the pad rather than a separate wide pill. Use cobalt #3468D4, tangerine #FF8A47, aqua #43C6B7, lemon #FFE064, raspberry #EF5D88, warm ivory #FFF8E9. Camera action is a yellow circular charm suspended below the board. Premium Scandinavian toy design, playful and modern, clean enough to focus on children's art, feasible in Expo/Skia. Page blank. Exact text "Buki" only. No device bezel, no extra labels, no large character, no gibberish.
